'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Operation Barkhane]]
***[[Sweden]] announces that it will withdraw its [[Swedish Army|troops]] from a [[French Armed Forces|French]]-led special forces mission in [[Mali]] later this year, in response to Mali's ruling [[military junta]] inviting private [[Russia]]n military contractors to fight [[Islamism|Islamist]] rebels. The deployment was originally expected to end in 2024. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/sweden-withdraw-french-led-special-forces-mission-mali-minister-2022-01-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Hunga Tonga eruption and tsunami]]
**The [[Hunga Tonga]], an undersea [[volcano]], erupts, sending ash and steam 20 kilometers into the air. The [[government of Tonga]] issues a [[tsunami warning]] and advises people in all [[islands of Tonga]] to avoid the coasts. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/459572/underwater-volcano-hunga-tonga-hunga-ha-apai-erupts-again (RNZ)]
* Magnitude 6.6 earthquake strikes Banten and Sumatra Island at 16:05 local time. 
** The earthquake hit 52 kilometres (32 miles) of a depth of 10 kilometres. There was no immediate reports of casualties though.

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
*****The [[Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases]] issues a resolution stating that all foreign nationals entering the [[Philippines]] must present proof of full [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccination]]. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/201730/canada-s-arabia-among-14-nations-now-under-phs-red-list-until-jan-31 (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
****The Philippines reports a record for the second consecutive day of 37,207 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 3,129,512. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/coronavirus-cases-philippines-january-14-2022/ (Rappler)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bhutan]]
****[[Bhutan]] reports its first 14 cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in people who travelled abroad. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/bhutan-reports-first-cases-of-omicron-coronavirus-variant/articleshow/88899051.cms (''The Economic Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] begins administering fourth doses of the COVID-19 vaccine for high-risk groups, including healthcare workers, government ministers, and members of the armed forces. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-health-cambodia-hun-sen-0f48302e6b10e20fba1ccdecaa3d5285 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record for the third consecutive day of 92,223 new cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/germany-sets-daily-record-with-over-90-000-new-covid-19-cases/2473934# (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[Sweden|Swedish]] [[Prime Minister of Sweden|Prime Minister]] [[Magdalena Andersson]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/01/14/world/europe/swedens-prime-minister-tests-positive-for-covid.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Brazil]]
****[[Brazil]] begins a [[COVID-19 vaccination]] program for children aged 5 to 11 years old with the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine]] despite objections from [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20220114-brazil-begins-vaccinating-young-children-despite-bolsonaro-objection (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uruguay]]
****[[Uruguay]] opens its borders to citizens and residents who have been infected with COVID-19. People will need to travel in private vehicles across the border and be in a family "bubble". [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/rare-move-uruguay-opens-borders-residents-infected-with-covid-19-2022-01-14/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
***[[Mexico|Mexican]] health regulator [[Federal Commission for the Protection against Sanitary Risk|COFEPRIS]] approves the emergency use of [[Pfizer]]'s anti-COVID-19 oral drug [[Paxlovid]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/mexico-approves-emergency-use-of-pfizers-covid-19-pills/article38272448.ece (''The Hindu'')]
*[[Earthquakes in Indonesia]]
**A magnitude 6.6 earthquake is felt in [[Java]] and neighbouring [[islands of Indonesia|islands]] in [[Indonesia]]. [https://en.antaranews.com/amp/news/209665/66-magnitude-earthquake-jolts-bantens-sumur-sub-district (Antara News)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/earthquake-indonesia-java-island-67-2436016 (CNA)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2022 Ukraine cyberattack]]
**Up to 70 [[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian government]] websites are affected by [[cyberattacks]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59992531 (BBC News)]

***The [[Minister for Immigration, Citizenship, Migrant Services and Multicultural Affairs|Minister for Immigration and Citizenship]], [[Alex Hawke]], invokes his ministerial powers under the [[Migration Act 1958]] to cancel [[Novak Djokovic]]'s [[travel visa|visa]] on "health and good order grounds".
